subject: CRM hygiene: normalize amounts, product mapping and next-step signals (board prep)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CRM hygiene: normalize amounts, product mapping and next-step signals (board prep)

Team —

Quick heads up: finance asked for a short cleanup so our Q4 board forecast reflects true commit. We have a commit review scheduled the week of Oct 10; I want the book in a state where the committed ARR/ACV and next steps are defensible. Please treat this as high priority.

What I need from each of you by EOD Friday, Oct 6:
- Amounts: confirm whether listed value is ACV or ARR. If the opportunity has multiple line items, split them into the line-item table in the CRM (product, qty, unit price). If the customer is purchasing term/one-time services, tag as "one-time" in the amount type.
- Product/SKU: map each opportunity product to our canonical SKU list (use the attached price_list_q4.pdf). If unsure, leave a comment in the product field and flag me.
- Next step: update the next_step field to one of: Contract Review, PO Pending, Exec Approval, Pilot Kickoff. Avoid vague entries like "Follow up" — we need specific signals.
- Probability: set probability to reflect the stage and evidence (e.g., PO received -> 95%; Negotiation -> 60%; Demo complete + verbal ok -> 70%). If you disagree with system default, add a one-line justification in the notes.

Attachments I dropped: acme_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (mutual action plan template), price_list_q4.pdf (canonical SKUs/pricing). I also linked the HubSpot deal below.

Why this matters: board wants a clean ARR number; mis-tagged amounts or missing SKUs skew our average deal size and the capacity plan. A few messy large deals can move the needle.

If you have dependencies on legal/compliance, call them out in the thread so I can escalate.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: acme_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), price_list_q4.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CRM hygiene: normalize amounts, product mapping and next-step signals (board prep)

Jonas — thanks for the clear ask. Quick status and a couple of questions inline.

On Mon, 01 Oct 2028 at 09:12, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick heads up: finance asked for a short cleanup so our Q4 board forecast reflects true commit.

Status: I'm triaging the top 30 deals by value this week. Plan:
- Thu 10/4: split multi-line deals and normalize SKUs (I'll use price_list_q4.pdf).
- Fri 10/5: reach out to three customers that have ambiguous next_steps.
- Mon 10/8: finalize probability updates and leave justifications in notes.

Questions:
1) ACME-1129 (Acme Corp) currently shows 1,200,000 but CRM stage is "Negotiation" with a signed LOI in Google Drive. Do you want me to mark as ACV or ARR? My recommendation: tag as ACV and add a note referencing the LOI; move next_step to "Contract Review."
2) For pilot deals that include credits, should we record list price ARR and a separate discount field, or record net ARR? My preference is list price + discount field to preserve unit pricing.

I can cover the ACME-1129 cleanup if you want me to reach out to Marta for confirmation.

—Lauren
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Next step on our side: Contract review complete -> PO issuance. Target PO date: Oct 10.

All —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and explicit asks before the Oct 10 commit review: 

1) ACME-1129:
- Action: Lauren to change amount to ACV = "600,000" and add a CRM note referencing the attached PO + DocuSign id. Set next_step = Contract Review and probability = 85% (PO expected 10/10).
- Owner: Lauren (done in CRM by EOD 10/09).

2) SKU mapping:
- Action: Grace to confirm RDW-DED-STND-4TB exists in price_list_q4.pdf. If missing, create mapping record and notify CS for provisioning.
- Owner: Grace (complete by 10/06; small follow-up allowed).

3) Multi-line deals and discounts:
- Action: Jonas to approve showing list price in ARR and recording discounts in the discount field; Sales Ops will split line items accordingly.
- Owner: Jonas (policy note added).

4) Evidence & notes:
- Action: Everyone: add one-line justification when you override system probability. Keep evidence links (PO/LOI/Email thread) in the CRM attachments section.

I'll run the commit report after EOD 10/09 and circulate to Finance and the Exec team. If anyone runs into a blocker (legal hold, procurement freeze) flag me and I'll escalate.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
